subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Does the exact merge result preserve the intended privileged production contract for authenticated requeues, durable command dispatch, captured execution gates, and final automerge authorization?
rationale: The code and tests support the implementation, but ownership of these production mutation and authorization boundaries requires explicit human intent rather than an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Approve Exact Contract
options.body: Confirm the synthetic merge result and current validation represent the intended fail-closed production semantics, then take the PR out of draft for normal merge handling.

options.title: Split Privileged Boundaries
options.body: Separate router dispatch, requeue authorization, staged-proof validation, and post-flight mutation changes if the combined contract is too broad to approve confidently.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact Contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the synthetic merge result and current validation represent the intended fail-closed production semantics, then take the PR out of draft for normal merge handling.
